# 1 Chronicles Chapter 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 384r–384v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_027_page_001.jpg, 1CH_027_page_002.jpg

---

**27:1** And-the-sons of-Yisra'el according-to-their-number, heads of-the-fathers and-commanders of-the-thousands and-the-hundreds, and-their-officers [shoterim] the-ones-serving [ha-mesharetim] the-king, for-every matter of-the-divisions [ha-machleqot] — the-coming [ha-ba'ah] and-the-going-out [ha-yotse'et] month by-month [chodesh be-chodesh] for-all the-months of-the-year — each division [was] twenty-four thousand.

**27:2** Over the-first division [ha-machleqet] for-the-first month — Yashov'am son of-Zavdi'el, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:3** From the-sons of-Perets, the-head of-all the-commanders of-the-hosts [sarey ha-tseva'ot] for-the-first month.

**27:4** And-over the-division of-the-second month — Dodai the-Achochi, and-his-division — and-Miqlot the-officer [ha-nagid], and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:5** The-commander of-the-host [sar ha-tsava], the-third, for-the-third month — Benayahu son of-Yehoyada the-priest [ha-kohen], the-head, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:6** This [is] Benayahu, the-mighty-man [gibbor] of-the-thirty, and-over the-thirty, and-his-division — Ammizavad his-son.

**27:7** The-fourth, for-the-fourth month — Asa'el brother of-Yo'av, and-Zevadyah his-son after-him, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:8** The-fifth, for-the-fifth month — the-commander [ha-sar] Shamhut the-Yizrachi, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:9** The-sixth, for-the-sixth month — Ira son of-Iqqesh the-Teqo'i, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:10** The-seventh, for-the-seventh month — Chelets the-Peloni, from the-sons of-Efrayim, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:11** The-eighth, for-the-eighth month — Sibbekhai the-Chushati, of-the-Zarchi, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:12** The-ninth, for-the-ninth month — Avi'ezer the-Anetoti, of-the-Binyamini, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:13** The-tenth, for-the-tenth month — Maharai the-Netofi, of-the-Zarchi, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:14** The-eleventh, for-the-eleventh month — Benayah the-Pir'atoni, of-the-sons of-Efrayim, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand. **27:15** The-twelfth, for-the-twelfth month — Cheldai the-Netofi, of-Otni'el, and-over his-division — twenty-four thousand.

**27:16** And-over the-tribes of-Yisra'el: for-the-Re'uveni — officer [nagid] — Eli'ezer son of-Zikhri; for-the-Shim'oni — Shefatyahu son of-Ma'akhah; **27:17** for-Levi — Chashabvyah son of-Qemu'el; for-Aharon — Tsadoq; **27:18** for-Yehudah — Elihu, from-the-brothers of-David; for-Yissakhar — Omri son of-Mikha'el; **27:19** for-Zevulun — Yishmayahu son of-Ovadyahu; for-Naftali — Yerimot son of-Azri'el; **27:20** for-the-sons of-Efrayim — Hoshe'a son of-Azazyahu; for-the-half tribe of-Menasheh — Yo'el son of-Pedayahu; **27:21** for-the-half of-Menasheh in-Gil'ad — Yiddo son of-Zekharyahu; for-Binyamin — Ya'asi'el son of-Avner; **27:22** for-Dan — Azar'el son of-Yerocham. These [are] the-commanders [sarey] of-the-tribes of-Yisra'el.

**27:23** And-not took David their-number from-a-son of-twenty years and-below, for said YHWH to-multiply [le-harbot] Yisra'el as-the-stars of-the-heavens [ke-kokhevey ha-shamayim]. **27:24** Yo'av son of-Tseruyah began to-count [limnot] but-not finished [lo kilah], and-was upon this wrath [qetsef] upon Yisra'el, and-not went-up the-number in-the-account [be-mispar] of-the-chronicles [divrey ha-yamim] of-the-king David.

**27:25** And-over the-treasuries [otserot] of-the-king — Azmavet son of-Adi'el. And-over the-treasuries in-the-field [ba-sadeh], in-the-cities, and-in-the-villages, and-in-the-towers [u-vamigdalot] — Yehonatan son of-Uzziyyahu. **27:26** And-over the-doers of-the-work [osey melekhet] of-the-field [ha-sadeh], for-the-tilling [la-avodat] of-the-ground [ha-adamah] — Ezri son of-Keluv. **27:27** And-over the-vineyards [ha-keramim] — Shim'i the-Ramati. And-over what [was] in-the-vineyards, for-the-treasuries [le-otserot] of-the-wine [ha-yayin] — Zavdi the-Shifmi. **27:28** And-over the-olive-trees [ha-zetim] and-the-sycamores [ha-shiqmim] which [were] in-the-Shefelah — Ba'al-Chanan the-Gederi. And-over the-treasuries of-the-oil [ha-shemen] — Yo'ash. **27:29** And-over the-cattle [ha-baqar] the-grazing in-Sharon — Shitrai the-Sharoni. And-over the-cattle in-the-valleys [ba-amaqim] — Shafat son of-Adlai. **27:30** And-over the-camels [ha-gemalim] — Ovil the-Yishme'eli. And-over the-donkeys [ha-atonot] — Yechdeyahu the-Meronoti. **27:31** And-over the-flocks [ha-tso'n] — Yaziz the-Hagri. All these [were] commanders [sarey] of-the-property [ha-rekhush] which [belonged] to-the-king David.

**27:32** And-Yehonatan, uncle of-David [dod David], [was] a-counselor [yo'ets], a-man of-understanding [mevin] and-a-scribe [sofer] — he. And-Yechi'el son of-Chakhomoni [was] with the-sons of-the-king. **27:33** And-Achitofel [was] a-counselor [yo'ets] to-the-king. And-Chushai the-Arki [was] the-friend of-the-king [re'eh ha-melekh]. **27:34** And-after Achitofel — Yehoyada son of-Benayahu, and-Evyatar. And-the-commander of-the-host [sar tsava] of-the-king — Yo'av.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — ha-ba'ah ve-ha-yotse'et (the-coming and-the-going-out):** The monthly rotation is described with the idiom of entering and leaving duty — a military concept applied to organized national service.

**v.23-24 — The incomplete census:** The Chronicler alludes to David's disastrous census (1 Chr 21) but from a different angle: David did not count those under twenty (respecting the divine promise), and Joab never completed the count because divine wrath intervened. The number was therefore never entered into "the chronicles of King David" (*divrey ha-yamim le-melekh David*) — a self-referential phrase, since the book's own title is *Divrey ha-Yamim*.

**v.33 — re'eh ha-melekh (friend of-the-king):** A formal court title, not merely a description of friendship. The *re'eh* was a trusted advisor with direct access to the king — comparable to a modern chief of staff.

*— EMET*
